nocturne: Tie batt disconnect state to DSG FET status. battery_get_disconnect_state() and the way that it is used in the EC code base essentially means "can the battery provide a charge?". This can be tied to the battery's discharge FET status. If the discharge FET is disabled, the battery cannot provide power to the system. This commit changes the decision to report the battery as disconnected to solely rely on the discharge FET status. Previously, we've seen issues where the charge FET was enabled, but the discharge FET was disabled due to a cell undervoltage issue. The EC would consider the pack as not "disconnected". However, this would signal to the system that the battery could provide charge, but in actuality it couldn't.
